The purpose of the Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) task is to correct grammatical errors in natural texts.

The purpose of the Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) task is to correct grammatical errors in natural texts. This includes correcting errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, morphology, word choice, and others.
outputs: Corrected sentences generated from errorful input sentences
corrected versions of errorful input sentences using sequence tagging with operations such as $KEEP, $DELETE, $APPEND_t, $REPLACE_t
